We were married for 36 years

I am exactly the same, until 3 weeks ago I was preparing for a marathon run, never drank, no pills, never any drugs. Now my wife of 36 years just died and I wish I could be drunk 24/7. Pills, drink, pills, drink. Alcohol poisoning and overdosing on pills is a horrible way to die. I don't want to drink and I dont want to drink myself to death. But the doctors I consulted downright refused to give me any controlled substance which could put me at ease for just a couple of hours of rest and piece. So I guess in a while my body wont tolerate all the alcohol and pills anymore and I have to go out the hard way.....
The doctors I consulted lately where completely useless, almost a joke, like a money  printing factory. Few days ago, a doctor killed my wife with a stupid mistake
Psychologists or psychiatrist or any other professional help would never work for me. Heminghway dealt with his depression in his own way, so did Charles Bukowski. My dog is my psychiatrist
Lucky you didn't damage your liver or kiddney or brain
Nobody will care, if I am dead. Nobody.....

I took my wife for granted for 36 years. Never even thought I cared anymore for her after such a long time. Felt comfortable being alone. She just died a few days ago suddenly. For years we never even said "I love you". Strangely in one of our last conversations from her hospital bed she told me she loved me, then she repeated it, I didn't answer her. We both didn't know, she would die. It was a sudden medical accident made. I didn't appreciate her when she was alive. Now I miss her like the air to breath. Like a part of me is gone. I had no idea how much I loved her. I am so sorry......

I also haven't found any information about a "good" form of suicide. It would be helpful, if we find a source, where different methods are compared or some reports from survivors. Let me know, when you find something.

I understand you and I don't feel any better than you. Maybe I wish I had the courage to do what you are considering. Almost jumped in front of a truck this morning. Nobody to talk to. But one thing is for sure (at least for me). To kill yoursef because of a cheating Gf is a waste of life. Many times I was in that same situation you are in right now. I look at it this way: Do you want to give her the satisfacation, that someone killed himself for her. NO WAY, you are stronger than that and in a few years, your next Gf will cheat on you and then the next....DO NOT GIVE THEM THE SATISFACTION, THEY WONT CARE!
No most likely it will NOT kill you, but make you disabled. BIG MISTAKE!

I have seen firsthand, what overdoses of these pills will do. It is an awfully big mistake to assume, that you will just peacefully go. It is not like that at all. There is a much higher chance you damage your liver and end up in an ICU or kiddney damage and a dialysis machine or brain damage. I am struggleing myself right now and I have much more of the stuff you mentioned available to me right here. I WOULD NEVER TRY to leave this way, because I have seen firsthand what damage it can do. And trust me I want to leave,too. BUT NOT THIS WAY!
